text:
Maya: heads up — sample-app onboarding failing on admin routes list. REST GET /v1/admin/routes returns 200+routes but node SDK admin.listRoutes() returns 404 for the same token. Anyone seen parity like this?

Leo: :eyes: saw something similar yesterday with the python SDK. param `include_hidden` was silently defaulting to false in the SDK but true in REST. Could be a defaults/serialization drift.

Sam: can you paste the minimal repro?

Maya: sure — REST curl works: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' 
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/admin/routes?include_hidden=true'
```
Node SDK (v2.3.1) call: 
```js
client.admin.listRoutes({ includeHidden: true })
  .then(r => console.log(r))
  .catch(e => console.error(e.status, e.message))
```
Output: `404 Not Found` (body: "route set not found")

Elena: interesting — sounds like a casing/param-name mapping bug. REST expects `include_hidden` snake_case; SDK uses camelCase `includeHidden`. We have a serializer layer that should translate but maybe misses this endpoint.

Sam: also check header precedence. We added `x-tenant` header in REST tests; SDK client might be dropping custom headers for admin endpoints.

Maya: quick log from proxy shows request to /v1/admin/routes arriving with `include_hidden=false` when using SDK. So param is being sent but with wrong default.

Elena: possible cause: recent admin refactor moved this endpoint to the new admin proxy and we updated REST client tests but forgot to add the param mapping in the SDK surface.

DeployBot: Deployed tag=admin-proxy-refactor to staging at 2025-09-20T15:02Z :rocket:

Leo: workaround for now: call the REST endpoint directly from the sample-app (ok for onboarding) or set explicit query string: `client._raw.get('/v1/admin/routes?include_hidden=true')` until SDK fix.

Maya: thanks. I'll open a GH issue with repro, add unit test for include_hidden mapping, and update sample-app to call REST as a hotfix.

Sam: assign to @Elena? seems in her area. :+1:

Elena: on it. I'll also add an e2e that compares SDK vs REST for admin routes to catch regressions. :bug:

Maya: appreciated. filing issue now.

(Reaction: Maya +1, Elena :eyes:)
